name: WF-B — Daily Blog Auto-Post (LongIslandConvenience.com)

nodes.name: Cron: 7AM EST Daily
nodes.notes: 12:00 UTC = 7:00 AM EST (8:00 AM EDT in summer). Adjust if needed.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: Long Island,Plainview NY,Nassau County,gift basket,convenience store

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: Long Island convenience store Plainview NY news 2026

parameters.body:
={
  "model": "dall-e-3",
  "prompt": "Professional lifestyle photo for a blog post about '{{ $json.title }}'. Long Island New York convenience store community. Bright, inviting, photorealistic. No text in image. Aspect ratio 16:9.",
  "n": 1,
  "size": "1792x1024",
  "quality": "standard",
  "response_format": "url"
}

nodes.name: HTTP: Odoo — Create Blog Post
nodes.notes: NOTE: Get session cookie by logging into Odoo in browser, copying the session_id cookie. Or use a Set Credentials HTTP node to authenticate first via /web/session/authenticate

nodes.name: HTTP: Trigger WF-A Social Blast
nodes.notes: Replace FILL_YOUR_N8N_BASE_URL with your n8n server URL, e.g. https://your-n8n.hostname.com

notes: WF-B: Daily Blog — runs at 7AM EST. Fill in: SERPAPI_KEY, Anthropic API key, OpenAI API key, Odoo session cookie, n8n base URL. Requires WF-A to be active for social sharing.
